assets.scope: Three compressed native connectivity database roundtrips and six rejection controls. Preserves initial loss of floating hierarchy and corrected retention-before-extraction requirement. Checks registered layers, units and sampled physical net equivalence after reload with pinned manifest/database/method/tool. Synthetic controls only; no fullchip database, LVS, timing or manufacturing acceptance.
